title: GIS APPS
text:
GIS APPS
GIS APPS
JACKSON COUNTY, MI
JACKSON COUNTY GIS
Our Mission
To provide Jackson County with the means to make informed decisions based on accurate and up-to-date information.
To meet the highest expectations held by the general public, private sector, and government agencies in the provision of quality GIS products and services.
Contact
Phone: 517-768-6692
email: gis@mijackson.org
ALL
GIS
JCDOT
PARKS
ATTENTION: Jackson County GIS applications will experience downtime in the following weeks due to system upgrades. We thank you for your patience and understanding.
ATTENTION!
Parcel Viewer
Find tax information for properties, generate mailing labels for public notification, print full page maps, and more. Updated weekly.
ATTENTION!
Natural Features
View natural features of Jackson County, including detailed soil and wetlands information, land use, and floodplains.
ATTENTION!
County Parks
Find detailed information and maps for the county parks
ATTENTION!
Historic Coal Mines
Learn more about the history of coal mining in Jackson County. Created by George Econ, Professor Emeritus of Jackson College.
ATTENTION!
Glacial Landforms
An in-depth lesson on the glacial landforms and terrain of Jackson County. Story by George Econ, Professor Emeritus of Jackson College & Geologist.
ATTENTION!
Plow Tracker
View the progress of county plow trucks over the past 12 hours. Updated live when snow events occur.
ATTENTION!
Zoning Viewer
View Jackson County zoning information.
ATTENTION!
Voting Info
View voting districts, commissioner districts, precincts, polling locations, school districts, and more.
ATTENTION!
Crime Viewer
View incidents reported by participating Jackson County law enforcement. Updated daily.
ATTENTION!
Non-Motorized Trails
Explore hiking, biking and recreational trails across Jackson County.
ATTENTION!
Imagery Viewer
Compare aerial imagery from years past to see how Jackson County has changed and developed.
ATTENTION!
2019 Printed Road Map PDF - Front
View or download the Official Jackson County 2019 Road Map - front side with full county (26"x36").
ATTENTION!
2019 Printed Road Map PDF - Back
View or download the Official Jackson County 2019 Road Map - back side with city zoom & index (26"x36").
